abstract: In this paper, 3D X-ray inspection is applied to the failure analysis of Fan-out advanced packaging. The Taguchi method was used to simplify the experimental condition combinations. Meanwhile, use Laplacian variance to identify and quantify the image clarity of copper fine lines in Fan-out packages.
